purpose: Fixed-budget supervision comparison. Both arms are newly trained from the same pretrained U2NETP initialization. No crop, palette, fitter, loss or acceptance-threshold tuning per photo. All added source groups already occur in training; the 32 evaluation photos remain source/duplicate separated. Native candidate reconstruction.

protocol.selection: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.
protocol.fits: Both native arms use the same pinned production detections/fits. Freshly fit each selected neural crop with the unchanged 10-second production fitter. No per-photo choice between model outputs; retain all 32 photos and all unresolved/failed fits.
protocol.validation: Independent exported weave error <=3%, original feature checks, geometry/paper checks, production editable conversion and independent editable-paper audit. Visual review of all photos/crops and distinct outputs.
protocol.missing: No manual rescue or result-dependent replacement. Record photo eligibility misclassifications and possible irregular weaving separately without removing them from primary denominators.
